validate_timestamp/validate_age use self.initial_data.get(...) which treats 0 as 'absent', allowing both age=0 and timestamp to pass the mutual-exclusion rule - should check key presence or 'is not None' instead of truthiness

zip(error_ids, events.values()) can misassociate event_id to data because get_multi() returns a dict whose value order isn't guaranteed to match error_ids/node_ids, and missing keys will silently drop IDs, leading to incorrect error context in Seer prompt
When use-table-widget-visualization is enabled, TableWidgetVisualization renders with columns=[] and empty tableData, so the table will always appear blank even when result.data/meta are present

Override detection uses 'if (cell)' which ignores valid ReactNodes like 0, empty string, or null and falls back to default renderer unexpectedly - should check 'cell !== undefined' instead (same issue in body-cell renderer)
_truncate_title slices to max_length and then appends '...', so the returned string can exceed ISSUE_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH by 3 characters
